projects.title: Life Quest
projects.tagline: An 8-bit daily quest for a better life
projects.description: A retro RPG-style dashboard of 45 lessons across 9 paths, each pairing a short reflection with a small real-world quest. A fair Daily Quest rotation with streaks, path progress, favourites, XP and levels.

projects.title: SkyFall
projects.tagline: Beneath the Red, a Future Awaits
projects.description: A cinematic, interactive hero for a Mars mission concept: three helicopters released mid-descent scan a procedural Mars for subsurface ice. Drag to turn the planet, click to ping it. Conceptual, not live mission data.
